verified_scope: Actual event transport and buffer handling in the explicitly enabled experimental source variant
original_diagnosis: Original IBAgent passes objc locks, workqueue feature check and implicit kqueue initialization. Its real pthread event pump is blocked in the embedded backend readiness wait. Original libdispatch now calls kevent_id with WORKLOOP|ERROR_EVENTS|IMMEDIATE (0x403) and traps on errno78, ENOSYS. BSD syscall375 has no source backend yet.
limits: Workloops/kevent_id are still unimplemented and WORKLOOP feature is not advertised.
QoS class / callback / TSD transport is verified; Darwin kernel scheduler, inheritance and overrides are not implemented by these checks. BSDTHREAD_CTL and SET_SELF feature bits remain clear.

Auxiliary default receive-buffer capacity follows the paired existing 64-byte libkqueue scratch buffer. Small caller buffers below64 return ENOTSUP; larger messages genuinely return MACH_RCV_TOO_LARGE and are retried through an explicit receive-buffer subscription.
Registration metadata is a bounded1024-slot table; all workloop lifecycle semantics and metadata cleanup on every FD reuse remain incomplete.
Standalone906-TU source kernel and13-TU pthread builds are tested. New full Darling CMake wiring is provided, but a cold complete CMake build is unverified.
Source fork changes are preserved with Comman Kang identity. No Apple binaries are published.
